name: nearme
description: NearMe social discovery and chat platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
